exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.rationale: Trunk anti-extension / flexion (abs). Hip flexors are not a tracked region.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.rationale: Trunk anti-extension / flexion (abs). Hip flexors are not a tracked region. Isometric, no length change. defaultM in repsEq (3 s each).

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.rationale: Trunk anti-extension / flexion (abs). Hip flexors are not a tracked region. Isometric, no length change. defaultM in repsEq (3 s each).

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.rationale: Trunk anti-extension / flexion (abs). Hip flexors are not a tracked region. Grip and lats only hang, so 0.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.rationale: Isometric lateral trunk support (obliques, counted as abs). Logged per side. defaultM in repsEq (3 s each).

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.rationale: Spinal flexion lying down: upper abs.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.rationale: Crunch with alternating rotation: abs and obliques; hip flexors drive the legs.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.rationale: Raising straight legs: abs hold the pelvis while hip flexors lift.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.rationale: Seated trunk rotation: obliques and abs.

exercises.name: V-up
exercises.rationale: Folding the trunk and legs together: abs through full spinal flexion.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.rationale: Opposite arm and leg reach on all fours: back extensors and glutes, abs resist rotation.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.rationale: Straight-leg raise hanging from a bar: longer lever than knee raises.

exercises.name: Toes to bar
exercises.rationale: Hanging leg raise all the way to the bar: full spinal flexion with the longest lever.

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
exercises.rationale: Pressing a band out from the chest while resisting rotation: anti-rotation core.

exercises.name: Band woodchop
exercises.rationale: Diagonal trunk rotation against a band: obliques and abs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side bend
exercises.rationale: Lateral spinal flexion holding a dumbbell: obliques and abs.

exercises.name: Weighted Russian twist
exercises.rationale: Seated trunk rotation holding a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.rationale: Walking with heavy dumbbells: grip, traps (counted under upper_back) and a braced trunk.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster
exercises.rationale: Front squat straight into an overhead press: quads and front delts lead.

exercises.name: Weighted crunch
exercises.rationale: Crunch with a dumbbell held on the chest: trunk flexion against load, abs.
